args.title: Fix parsing of amounts with leading decimal
args.body:
File: src/ingest/schema.ts

Currently, amounts like .75 or -.50 are not being parsed correctly if they are missing a leading zero. Update the amount parsing logic to handle numbers starting with a decimal point (e.g., .75) properly.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parsing logic in `src/ingest/schema.ts` currently does not handle amounts with a leading decimal point (e.g., .75) correctly, causing the error 'The amount is not a number'. The fix will involve updating the parsing logic to account for these cases.
